newsitem.title: USA: CKE Restaurants to form Star Buffet unit.
newsitem.headline: CKE Restaurants to form Star Buffet unit.

text.p: CKE Restaurants Inc said Monday it formed a new subsidiary called Star Buffet Inc, and it plans to sell an about 55 percent interest in the unit.
In addition, the company said it signed a letter of intent for a strategic alliance with Stacey's Buffet Inc.

CKE said the new unit's operations will include the 16 HomeTown Buffet restaurants operated by a subsidiary of Summit Family Restaurants Inc -- called HTB Restaurants Inc -- and two Casa Bonita Mexican theme restaurants.
